question: A scout camp shared 80 logs equally among its 4 campfires. The leaders then added 5 more logs to the fire by the lake. Every log on that fire burns for 3 hours. The campsite is 7 kilometres from the village shop. For each hour a fire burns, the troop uses 5 fire lighters from the store. How many fire lighters will the fire by the lake use?

Sofia's nursery raised 178 seedlings in each of its 8 greenhouses. Every one of those seedlings produced 7 cuttings. Her assistant Dan contributed 61 cuttings from his own bench, far fewer than Sofia had raised. The nursery runs 3 delivery vans and lists its growing times in weeks rather than in months. A garden chain bought 5138 cuttings, and 623 more failed to root. A customer later returned 49 cuttings that had arrived too late to plant. How many cuttings does the nursery still have?

Early on Monday morning a warehouse shared 192 rolls of ribbon equally among its 6 gift-wrapping stations. Later that morning 79 more rolls were delivered to the first station. In the afternoon 18 rolls at that station were used up and thrown away. Every roll still at the first station is 9 metres long. How many metres of ribbon does the first station have?

Nadir had 44 sheets of coloured card and used 19 of them on a wall display. Each sheet that was left can be cut into 7 name badges. His colleague Priya made 49 badges of her own, which was fewer than Nadir cut from his card. The staffroom has 16 chairs around the table. For the second open evening the school tripled the number of badges it was holding. How many badges did the school have then?

A courier depot had 148 parcels at dawn, and a rival firm collected 59 of them. A morning shipment then doubled the number of parcels still in the depot. A shop dropped off 57 more parcels before noon. Every parcel in the depot weighs 9 pounds, and the depot records its loads in pounds rather than in tons. What is the total weight, in pounds, of the parcels in the depot?

A market gardener sowed 41 rows of beans, but 21 of the rows failed in the drought. Each surviving row holds 4 plants. Every one of those plants produced 9 pods this summer. A neighbour gave the gardener 77 more pods from her own plot. The gardener's shed is 12 years old. She sold 343 pods at the Saturday market. How many pods does she still have?

On Saturday morning Ines baked 33 loaves, and her partner Otto baked exactly the same number, so 2 equal batches sat on the bench. The loaves were loaded equally into 2 vans, and the first van drove to the market. In the afternoon each loaf in that van was cut into 6 tasting slices. Otto then brought over a tray of 33 more slices, fewer than Ines had cut. The stall laid out that same spread of slices on each of its 3 tasting tables. By closing time 515 slices had been eaten. How many slices were left?

A print shop had 224 sheets of card in the store, a supplier added 20 sheets, and a school donated 44 more. All of the sheets were then shared equally among the 6 workshop tables. The first table later received 70 extra sheets from a cancelled order. The workshop building has 9 windows along its front. The shop counts its card in single sheets rather than in reams. How many sheets are on the first table?

Kwame bought 34 packs of trading cards and gave 18 of them to his sister Amara, who was left holding more packs than he had kept. Each pack Kwame still has holds 8 sheets. Every sheet has 6 pockets on it. Each pocket holds 8 cards. How many cards does Kwame have?

Lin sowed 9 rows of sunflowers with 63 seeds in every row. Her brother Theo sowed exactly the same number of seeds in his own field, so the 2 of them put the same amount into the ground. A garden club then donated 78 extra seeds to the pair. Mice ate 163 of all those seeds before they could sprout. Their village has 40 houses. How many seeds were left to grow?

A pharmacy had 60 boxes of vitamin tablets and sold 37 boxes during the week. It sent 7 more boxes back to the supplier because the labels were wrong. The pharmacy has stood on the high street since 1988. Every box still on the shelf holds 5 packets, each packet holds 2 sachets, and each sachet contains 6 tablets. How many tablets are on the shelf?

A cinema archive held 105 film reels, and 19 of them were too damaged to keep. Each reel that survived carries 3 short films. A hard drive in the office holds another 14 short films. The projector in the main screen was installed 22 years ago, and the archive lists all its running times in minutes rather than in hours. A studio then reclaimed 96 of the short films. How many short films does the archive have?

A market trader had 67 crates of oranges and sold 23 of them before noon. He then tripled the number of crates he was holding by buying from a wholesaler. A rival took 32 crates off his hands, and a farmer delivered 34 more. Every crate holds 6 kilograms of oranges, and the trader weighs his stock in kilograms rather than in tonnes. A late delivery added 77 kilograms of loose oranges to the same van. How many kilograms of oranges are in his van?

On Monday morning a mill ran 9 looms, and each loom wove 107 metres of ribbon. Before lunch a supplier delivered another 27 metres of the same ribbon. In the afternoon every metre in the mill was cut into 6 short strips. A worker found 36 more strips left over from Friday and added them to the pile. That evening a shop bought 848 strips, and a wholesaler collected another 1190. How many strips were left in the pile?

At the start of Monday a food bank had 111 parcels ready on the racks. During the morning volunteers packed 80 more, and before lunch a supermarket sent in 51. In the afternoon a school collection added 62 parcels. That evening 34 parcels were driven out to families. Late at night a bakery van dropped off 72 more parcels. How many parcels does the food bank have now?

A theatre had 137 costumes in store, a wardrobe sale added 68, and a closing production donated 61 more. A touring company then borrowed 221 costumes. Each costume left in the store needs 4 repairs before the new season. Every repair takes 9 minutes, and the wardrobe team records its work in minutes rather than in hours. The theatre seats 500 people. How many minutes of repair work does the store need?

A wildlife park has 3 aviaries, and each aviary holds 63 birds. Every bird eats 9 grams of seed each day. The keepers add another 39 grams a day for the chicks in the nursery. A dozen keepers work at the park over the summer. The feed is weighed in grams rather than in kilograms, and the head keeper needs the total for a trip lasting 4 days. How many grams of seed are needed for those 4 days?

A cobbler had 20 pairs of laces in his drawer and used 18 pairs on Monday's repairs. A supplier delivered 63 pairs on Tuesday. A closing-down shop sold him 55 pairs, and a market stall added another 71 pairs. Half of the drawer is taken up by tins of polish. The shop opens at 8 every morning. How many pairs of laces are in the drawer?

A school had 190 exercise books in the cupboard and sent 170 of them to a partner school. Every book still in the cupboard has 7 blank pages left in it. A teacher added 40 loose pages from a spare pad to the same cupboard. Half the class was away with flu that week. The school counts this stock in single pages rather than in books, and each page holds 3 exercises. How many exercises can the cupboard's pages hold?

On Monday morning Aled had 32 planks in the workshop and used 20 of them on a staircase. The planks that were left were shared equally among the 4 workbenches, and Aled took the share at his own bench. In the afternoon he cut each of his planks into 4 shelves, more shelves than his apprentice Cerys managed all day. Cerys then filled every shelf he had made with 9 books. That evening a trolley brought 80 more books into the workshop. How many books are in the workshop?

A council nursery grew 151 young trees and bought 47 more from a supplier. Every one of those trees was planted together with 3 shrubs. Each shrub was grown from 3 cuttings taken the year before. The nursery van makes 5 trips a week. All of those cuttings were counted and shared equally among the 6 parks in the town. How many cuttings went to one park?

Ana counted 162 sacks of rice in the store, and her colleague Bo added 14 sacks, fewer than the 25 sacks a lorry brought in later that day. Every sack in the store is split into 9 bags. Each bag fills 9 cups. Every cup holds 9 spoonfuls of rice. A cook then found 56 loose spoonfuls in a jar and added them to the count. How many spoonfuls of rice does the store hold?

On Saturday morning a garden centre had 101 trays of bulbs on display. The staff destroyed 12 trays that had gone mouldy in the rain. During the afternoon 81 trays were sold to customers. Half of the car park was closed for resurfacing that day. Every tray still on display in the evening holds 5 pots, and each pot contains 6 bulbs. How many bulbs were still on display?

A community radio station had 201 minutes of interviews recorded and deleted 181 minutes that were unusable. A guest added 76 minutes of new material, and a jingle added 3 minutes more. The station lists its output in minutes rather than in hours. For the anniversary week the producer tripled the length of the whole programme by repeating it with fresh links. How many minutes long is the anniversary programme?

Farah had 215 bricks stacked beside the shed, and her cousin Idris brought 38 more, a smaller load than hers. A skip firm added another 24 bricks to the same stack. Every brick in the stack weighs 6 pounds. A single stone slab weighing 18 pounds is stored on top of them. The shed door is 2 metres wide. What is the total weight, in pounds, of the stack?
